values.meaning: duration the mark lasts before expiring
values.quote: marks the first enemy {{tip|champion}}, epic {{tip|monster}}, or {{tip|structure}} hit for 4 seconds

values.meaning: mana restored if mark detonated by an ability
values.quote: '''Ezreal''' restores {{sti|mana|{{as|60 mana}}}} plus the {{as|mana cost}} of that ability
values.binNote: Wiki restricts mana restore to ability-triggered detonations only, matching bin field name; the additional refund of the triggering ability's mana cost is not separately represented in the bin.

mechanics.claim: Essence Flux itself deals 0 proc damage on application; the mark is only detonated (and deals damage) by the next basic attack or ability against the target.
mechanics.quote: The application of ''Essence Flux'' deals 0 {{tip|proc damage}}.

mechanics.claim: The next basic attack or ability on the marked target detonates the mark, dealing the bonus magic damage as a separate instance.
mechanics.quote: His next {{tip|basic attack}}<!--on-hit? on-damage?--> or {{tip|ability}} against the target detonates the mark to deal them {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Mana is only restored if the mark was detonated by an ability, not a basic attack.
mechanics.quote: If the mark was detonated with an ability, '''Ezreal''' restores {{sti|mana|{{as|60 mana}}}} plus the {{as|mana cost}} of that ability.
